subject: Intro + quick qualification / demo for CareWell Health
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@carewell.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request (self-serve sign-up)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for reaching out — I signed up for a trial this morning (CareWell runs a small pilot environment for patient intake automation). Happy to do a quick demo. A few quick details to help qualify: 

- Use case: ingest patient intake forms (PDFs + free text), generate structured summaries and triage flags for care coordinators; embed search for historical patient notes.
- Expected volume: ~600-1,200 docs/month initially, scaling to ~10k/month over 6-9 months if pilot succeeds.
- Latency requirements: near real-time for interactive workflows (sub-2s for generation in most cases), batch for nightly processing is fine.
- Timeline: pilot kickoff in September; decision for production rollout by end of Q4.

I have availability next week Tue/Wed between 11:00-15:00 PT. Let me know what works.

Thanks,
Samir
Director of Product
CareWell Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Hi Samir — great context, thanks for the details.

Quick follow-ups so we can tailor the demo:
- For the PDFs, are they high-structure (templated intake forms) or a lot of free-form notes + scanned documents?
- Do you expect PHI to be processed in the pilot? (helps determine deployment / T&Cs)
- Any internal SLOs for throughput (docs/hour) besides the interactive latency target?

I can do Wed 8/18 at 11:30am PT or 1:30pm PT. Ava (cc'd) will join to cover integration/embedding stories. If neither slot works, here's my Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min — pick a time that suits you and I'll send an invite and agenda.

Agenda for the call (attached as a short PDF): 1) 10m quick intro + goals, 2) 15m demo with PDF/embedding examples, 3) 5-10m next steps (pilot timeline, pricing, security).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Thanks — answers below and I booked the 1:30pm PT slot.

- PDFs: mix of templated intake forms (~60%) and free-form clinician notes (scanned OCRed) for the rest.
- PHI: yes, pilot will include PHI; we'll need to talk about options (Private deploy / VPC, SOC2 evidence, data residency).
- Throughput: realistic pilot peak ~500 docs/hour during business hours; nightly batch could be ~3-4k processed.

Booked 8/18 1:30pm PT via your Calendly link. Looking forward to the demo.

Samir
